**Download `GlobalS.html` below, then double-click it.** It opens in Microsoft Edge (or Chrome) — there's nothing to install.

- Every active satellite in real time on a 3D globe, with passes over Cebu City (or anywhere you set) and a radar of your sky.
- It needs internet the first time, for the satellite data. After that it also starts offline, with the last data it downloaded.
- The satellite data is refreshed on GitHub every 6 hours and the app picks it up by itself, so you only need a new copy of the file when there's a new version of GlobalS.

If Windows or your browser asks whether to keep the download, choose **Keep** — it's a web page, not a program.
